thread:
taylor - AE: SentBank wants to stand up a 3-day PrivateDeploy PoC next week. They listed blockers: 1) require static egress IPs for their perimeter allowlist; 2) need TLS inspection on some internal FQDNs but not all; 3) need demonstrable preservation of client identity for audit. Can SE/NetEng/Sec propose options and quick runbook? @kyle @leila @sam

kyle - SE: TL;DR: PrivateLink (interface VPCE) is easiest for isolating traffic but it terminates at our ENI so original source IP is not preserved to the service. If they need true source IP at the backend, options are: a) customer-side proxy that injects X-Forwarded-For; b) VPC peering / transit with NAT preserving client IPs (more ops + routing exposure); c) Dedicated reserved egress IP block we route from (we can present as static egress).

leila - NetEng: Additions from networking POV:
- PrivateLink behavior: VPCE -> our ENI; source becomes connector subnet. No native client IP preservation across VPCE.
- If they adopt a customer proxy, recommend a lightweight reverse proxy (nginx/envoy) in their VPC that terminates TLS, forwards upstream with X-Forwarded-For, and preserves SNI in the TLS ClientHello to allow their inspector to see it.
- For peering/transit: requires route leaks and likely a Transit Gateway. Works but requires longer ops runway and ACL updates.

kyle - SE: Minimal firewall snippet they can drop into perimeter (replace placeholders):

```
# Allow outbound to Redwood PrivateDeploy egress pool (examples)
ALLOW TCP 443 to 203.0.113.0/24  # redwood-reserved-egress-region-1
ALLOW TCP 443 to 198.51.100.0/24 # redwood-ingest
# If using VPCE (PrivateLink), allow VPCE IPs or resolve vpce-id.region.vpce.amazonaws.com
ALLOW TCP 443 to vpce-abcde123.region.vpce.amazonaws.com
```

leila - NetEng: Network caveats to share with them:
- MTU: VPN/DirectConnect with jumbo frames can break streaming if path MTU not preserved. Recommend 1500 baseline or enable MSS clamping.
- TCP idle timeouts: corporate proxies sometimes drop idle streams around 60s. Recommend keepalive ping or shorter chunk intervals for streaming.
- Session affinity: if they front our service with a proxy, ensure sticky sessions or pass the X-Stream-ID header so KV cache stays warm for low-latency inference.

sam - Security: Regarding TLS inspection  we can't advise customers to MITM our client-to-server TLS in a way that breaks our certificate validation or function-level security (e.g., client cert pinning). Standard compromise: customer exempts a short list of internal FQDNs from inspection so traffic remains E2E. For sign-off we need:
- Exact FQDNs and IPs proposed for exemption
- Business justification / threat model for each exemption
- SIEM/Syslog endpoint and log retention requirements
- Whether they require HSM-backed keys on our side (if yes, timeline extends and needs contract addendum)

taylor - AE: Procurement asked about cost delta if customer runs proxy vs we provide static egress from Dedicated. Quick answer?

kyle - SE: Cost tradeoffs:
- Customer-managed proxy: zero extra Redwood infra charge, but customer covers proxy infra and ops. Faster on contract side.
- Redwood-managed static egress (Dedicated): we reserve and advertise a /29 or similar per region. This is an add-on to Dedicated capacity and carries a monthly charge (egress reservation + SLA). I'll add an estimate line to the quote.

infra-bot: Internal ticket created: DED-EGRESS-8123 - Reserve /29 for SentBank in us-east-1 for PoC. Tentative maintenance window: 2024-11-02 03:00-04:00 UTC.

taylor - AE: Actions for PoC next week:
- kyle: draft two runbooks (A: VPCE + customer-proxy pattern that preserves X-Forwarded-For; B: Dedicated reserved-eps static-egress flow) and attach firewall snippets + sample proxy config.
- leila: add MTU and keepalive tuning checklist and sample envoy/nginx config for X-Forwarded-For and stream timeouts.
- sam: one-page security checklist with required FQDN list fields and HSM/cert questions for legal if needed.

kyle - SE: Will upload runbooks and quote stub by EOD tomorrow.

leila - NetEng: If they pick Dedicated egress please confirm we can get signed commitment before Tue morning so ops can pre-allocate the /29.

taylor - AE: Noted. I'll update SentBank and request their FQDN list + procurement timeline. Thanks team :pray:
